name: io.github.readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy
title: readfetch
description: Stdio MCP proxy: free probe, then x402-paid ReadFetch tools; for hosts that cannot sign x402.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base mainnet wallet for paid tools; omit for readfetch_probe and tools/list only

environmentVariables.name: READFETCH_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USD per x402 authorization (default 1, max 100)

environmentVariables.name: READFETCH_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Upstream MCP URL for tools/list (default https://readfetch.com/mcp)

environmentVariables.name: READFETCH_DEV
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for localhost/Sepolia dev only; never with production READFETCH_MCP_URL
